source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to space and environment (PDF 169-170).

blocks.text: Khala (space) aur mahol do qareebi shobe hain jo kainat aur hamare sayyare dono ko samajhne mein madad dete hain. Khala zameen ki fiza se aage ka woh ilaqa hai jahan sayyare, sitare aur kehkashanein jaise tamam falkiyati ajsam maujood hain aur kashish-e-saql aur electromagnetic shuaon ke zariye aik doosre par asar karte hain. Mahol woh tabai, kimiyai aur hayatiyati halaat hain jin mein jandaar aur be-jaan nizam maujood aur aik doosre par asar-andaz hain: hawa, pani, zameen, mausam, ecosystems aur zameen par zindagi ko sahara dene wale tamam qudrati amal.

Yeh chapter dekhta hai ke sitare tawanai kaise kharij karte hain (luminosity), falkiyati faasle napne ke liye standard candles aur redshift kaise use hote hain, aur shuaon ke qawaneen sitaron ka darja hararat aur size andaza lagane mein kaise madad dete hain. Yeh yeh bhi dekhta hai ke zameen ka mausami nizam hawa, pani, barf, zameen aur zindagi ke baahami amal se kaise chalta hai, aur yeh Sooraj ki tawanai, hawa aur samandari gardish par kaise radd-e-amal dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein 'khala' aur 'mahol' mein kya farq hai?
